user.title: Find a Sport Clips salon
user.description: Leave blank to find salons near your Home Assistant location, or enter a city or ZIP code to search elsewhere. Your chosen search location is sent to Sport Clips. No account is needed.

salon.title: Choose a salon
salon.description: One salon per entry. Repeat setup to monitor more salons.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the provider. Wait before retrying; provider cooldowns are honored.
error.no_locations: No geographic suggestions found. Try another city or ZIP code.
error.no_salons: No salons found in this area. Try another city, ZIP code or geographic location.
error.invalid_search: Enter a city or ZIP code (up to 128 characters), or leave blank to use your Home Assistant location.
error.invalid_home_location: Home Assistant has no valid location. Enter a city or ZIP code instead, or configure your home location in Home Assistant.

init.title: Polling interval
init.description: Choose whole minutes from 1 to 60. Existing polling and provider cooldowns are preserved.
